description: Set the herring and the loaf, and reported the cat.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Counted the threepence, refused a proverb, and named her hours.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Preferred the table to the loom for the length of the meal, then went back.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat, looked at the notch, and did not rehearse.
name: William Shakespeare
